stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Amelia Voght and Byron Calley serve on Asteroid M after Cortez seizes it. Cortez orders Calley to fire the missiles at Earth, and Calley refuses. When Cortez turns on him, Amelia stops him.
stages.whoA: Asteroid M's missile officer, whom she saves from Cortez
stages.whoB: The Asteroid M resident who stops Cortez from killing him

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Leech's flight from a mob draws Cyclops and Jean to the Morlocks, and Annalee lulls them to sleep for Callisto. Below, Leech switches off Cyclops' powers.
stages.whoA: A Morlock boy who helps draw Cyclops below
stages.whoB: The Morlock whose song lulls Cyclops to sleep

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: With Leech gravely ill and refused by a hospital, Annalee helps steal an ambulance for medicine and begs Storm for help. A transfusion of Wolverine's blood saves the boy.
stages.whoA: The sick Morlock boy she fights to save
stages.whoB: A Morlock who steals an ambulance to save him

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Annalee's song puts Cyclops and Jean to sleep, and Callisto sends Sunder to carry them below. Both serve Callisto when the X-Men come to the rescue.
stages.whoA: The Morlock strongman who carries her captives below
stages.whoB: The Morlock who lulls his captives to sleep

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Pooyetah overrules Kiyoek, who wants to trade the half frozen Wolverine for a reward, and later scolds his jealousy. Kiyoek then helps Wolverine save Pooyetah and the others from Sabretooth.
stages.whoA: The elder of his camp, whose word is law
stages.whoB: A jealous young man of his camp

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Bantam rides with Fitzroy to wreck Forge's time portal for Master Mold. In 1959, warned that Master Mold will destroy them both, Fitzroy gives up the hit on Xavier and flees with Bantam.
stages.whoA: His partner, who spares Xavier to save them both
stages.whoB: His partner on Master Mold's time mission

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Master Mold sends Bantam and Fitzroy to destroy Forge's time portal. Then he orders Nimrod to kill the pair once the job is done.
stages.whoA: The Sentinel master who plans to have him killed
stages.whoB: Fitzroy's partner, whom he marks for death

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Master Mold distrusts Fitzroy and sends Nimrod with him to 1959 to kill Xavier. When Fitzroy reports success, Master Mold sends him after Forge's portal and secretly orders Nimrod to kill him.
stages.whoA: The Sentinel master who plans to betray him
stages.whoB: The mutant assassin he means to discard

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: The High Evolutionary checks Wanda's DNA, sends her after Magneto and then traps her in Wundagore. He uses her powers to breed his new race and tells her Magneto is her father.
stages.whoA: Pietro's twin, whose powers he uses for his new race
stages.whoB: The master of Wundagore who traps her

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: The High Evolutionary confirms Pietro's identity by his DNA, sends him after Magneto, then captures him. He uses Pietro's speed for his new race and names Magneto as his father.
stages.whoA: Wanda's twin, whose speed he uses for his new race
stages.whoB: The master of Wundagore who traps him

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Pietro and Wanda learn from Django that they were adopted and seek the truth in Wundagore together. They attack Magneto to avenge their mother, then learn he is their father.
stages.whoA: His twin sister
stages.whoB: Her twin brother

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Bova, the midwife who left the newborn Wanda with Django, tells her how her mother fled a mutant and died. She warns that the name brings suffering, then names Magneto.
stages.whoA: One of the twins she once placed with Django
stages.whoB: The midwife who cared for her as a baby

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: The High Evolutionary, master of Wundagore and maker of its creatures, brings the twins to Bova. After her story, he agrees revenge brings bloodshed, yet sends his creatures with them.
stages.whoA: The master of Wundagore who made her
stages.whoB: The midwife of Wundagore, one of his creations

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Bova tells Pietro and his sister how their mother fled a mutant, left them with her and died. When the twins demand a name, she gives them Magneto.
stages.whoA: One of the twins she once placed with Django
stages.whoB: The midwife who cared for him as a baby

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: From his hospital bed, Django tells Wanda that he and Marya raised her but are not her real parents. He sends her and Pietro to find the midwife Bova in Wundagore.
stages.whoA: The daughter he raised
stages.whoB: The man who raised her

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: From his hospital bed, Django tells Pietro that he and Marya raised him but are not his real parents. He sends him and Wanda to find the midwife Bova in Wundagore.
stages.whoA: The son he raised
stages.whoB: The man who raised him

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Yoshida scolds Soichi for training villagers to fight and insists they keep paying the Silver Samurai. Soichi defies him, rallies the people to resist and wins.
stages.whoA: The village elder who wants to keep paying
stages.whoB: The hotheaded young man who defies him

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Kisara introduces her wild brother Soichi to Logan at the village feast. She backs his fight against the Silver Samurai and begs Logan to help him.
stages.whoA: Her hotheaded brother
stages.whoB: His sister

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: At the feast for Logan, village elder Yoshida sends Kisara to show the guest to the table. She later asks Logan to help the fight that Yoshida wants to avoid.
stages.whoA: The elder of her village
stages.whoB: A young woman of his village

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Master Oku brings Logan to the village feast and introduces him to Yoshida. Trusting the monk, Yoshida welcomes the stranger too.
stages.whoA: The elder of the nearby fishing village
stages.whoB: The monk whose word he trusts

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Talos tries to capture Maverick and the others for reprogramming. Maverick scans the robot for its power source and plants a thermite grenade inside its armor.
stages.whoA: The failsafe robot that tries to reprogram him
stages.whoB: One of the subjects it is set to recapture

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Silver Fox and Maverick lure Logan back to the Weapon X ruins to learn what was done to their minds. She directs the fight against Talos, and Maverick plants the grenade.
stages.whoA: His old comrade, plagued by the same false memories
stages.whoB: Her old comrade from the Weapon X days

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Toad is Solarr's enforcer in Skull Mesa and keeps Dr. Prescott frozen in his resin. On Solarr's order he and Lambert drag Cyclops into town for execution.
stages.whoA: The resin slinging thug who does his dirty work
stages.whoB: The boss of his gang in Skull Mesa

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Solarr seizes Skull Mesa's gold mine, and when Dr. Prescott opposes him, has him frozen in Toad's resin. When the town turns on Solarr, Prescott is freed and decides the town will judge him.
stages.whoA: Skull Mesa's founder, the one man who opposed him
stages.whoB: The mutant who seized his town and froze him

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Solarr orders Watchdog to shoot down Cyclops' plane, and Watchdog jams his call for help. As the town rises, Watchdog turns on Solarr and calls in the X-Men.
stages.whoA: The guard who downs Cyclops' plane, then turns on him
stages.whoB: The boss he serves, then turns against

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Tusk, a mechanic who fixes Solarr's generator, is too scared to help Cyclops at first. When the town rises, he is among the first to rebel against Solarr.
stages.whoA: A frightened mechanic who rises against him
stages.whoB: The mutant whose gang rules his town

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Toad's resin keeps Dr. Prescott in suspended animation for Solarr. Prescott is freed when the townsfolk overthrow Solarr's gang.
stages.whoA: Solarr's thug, whose resin keeps him frozen
stages.whoB: The doctor he keeps frozen for Solarr

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Chet Lambert echoes every word as Braddock warns Cyclops to leave Skull Mesa. Once Braddock shows himself as Solarr, Lambert drags Cyclops out for execution on his order.
stages.whoA: His boss, Bill Braddock, who calls himself Solarr
stages.whoB: The henchman who echoes his every word

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Lambert and Toad are Solarr's partners in seizing Skull Mesa. Together they mock and beat the powerless Cyclops, then drag him to the center of town.
stages.whoA: His fellow thug in Solarr's gang
stages.whoB: His fellow thug in Solarr's gang

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Solarr frightens Dr. Tanaka into silence about Prescott and keeps the whole town in fear. When Cyclops faces execution, Tanaka at last stands against Solarr.
stages.whoA: The tyrant who frightens him into silence
stages.whoB: The town doctor he cows into silence
